name: Oliver House (1859, NRHP), 27 Broadway
refs: refs/w8000145707/00 (OliverHouseToledo, Wikimedia Commons); Successful Sales, Oliver House
notes: Greek Revival hotel by Isaiah Rogers: three to four storeys of red brick with tall 6-over-6 windows and stone sills, a white entablature cornice running round the curved corner, low flat roof; brewpub at grade.
